description: A group of 3 wild elephants spotted crossing the stream near the patrol point. No immediate danger to tourists, but monitoring is required.
Found 4 wire snares hidden in the underbrush 200m East of the trailhead. Snares have been removed and logged.
Minor fire detected near the rocks. Likely caused by a discarded cigarette. Extinguished by the patrol team.
Male Sambar deer found with a leg injury. Veterinary team has been notified for pickup.
Group of 4 tourists found camping outside designated zones. Issued warnings and escorted back to the main site.
Discovery of 2 freshly cut Rosewood trees. Area cordoned off for investigation.
Large amount of plastic waste left behind by weekend visitors. Cleanup requested.
Water level in the stream has risen by 50cm following heavy rain upstream. Recommend temporary closure of the waterfall path.
The wooden railing on the East trail is rotted and has partially collapsed. Hazardous for hikers.
Great Hornbill pair spotted nesting in a large Dipterocarp tree. Requesting restricted access to this specific trail section.
Black pickup truck with no license plate seen near the eastern boundary at 02:00 AM.
Observed oil sheen on the water surface near the waterfall basin. Source unknown.
